stills.prompt: The same vaulted chamber and stone table as @master, camera lower and closer on the tabletop: the fine gold chain lies in its loop on the dark stone beside a deep crack, pulled taut. The brass lantern hangs above, a faint fall of dust drifting through its light. No people, no hands, no lettering. Near-black charcoal stone, one warm light from the brass lantern above, strong gold-on-black contrast readable at phone size. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.

Close on the dark stone tabletop of @master: a broken fine gold chain lies slack and still on bare stone, its loose end pointing toward the dark arched doorway, which is soft and out of focus behind. One adult hand in a plain dark sleeve rests at the right edge of the frame, not yet touching the chain. No face, no second hand, no lettering. Near-black charcoal stone, one warm light from the brass lantern above, strong gold-on-black contrast readable at phone size. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.

Low wide view from the near end of the stone table in @master: the fine gold chain lies loosely across the bare dark tabletop, its end at the table's far edge, pointing at the arched doorway, which opens onto darkness. The lantern hangs still. No people, no hands, no lettering. Near-black charcoal stone, one warm light from the brass lantern above, strong gold-on-black contrast readable at phone size. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.
